description:
Retrieves the space role assignments.

Available on tenants with [Role-Based Access Control](https://support.atlassian.com/confluence-cloud/docs/manage-user-roles/). 

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to view the space.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the space for which to retrieve assignments.

parameters.name: role-id
parameters.description: Filters the returned role assignments to the provided role ID.

parameters.name: role-type
parameters.description: Filters the returned role assignments to the provided role type.

parameters.name: principal-id
parameters.description: Filters the returned role assignments to the provided principal id. If specified, a principal-type must also be specified. Paired with a `principal-type` of `ACCESS_CLASS`, valid values include [`anonymous-users`, `jsm-project-admins`, `authenticated-users`, `all-licensed-users`, `all-product-admins`]

parameters.name: principal-type
parameters.description: Filters the returned role assignments to the provided principal type. If specified, a principal-id must also be specified.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the `next` URL in the `Link` response header. Use the relative URL in the `Link` header to retrieve the `next` set of results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of space roles to return. If more results exist, use the `Link` response header to retrieve a relative URL that will return the next set of results.

200.description: Returned if the requested space role assignments are retrieved.

400.description: Returned if an invalid request is provided.

401.description:
Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing
from the request.

404.description:
Returned if the calling user does not have permission to view the
space or the space was not found.
